units.title: Introduction of Metalliferous Mining
topics: 1.1. Historical development of metalliferous mining, Trend of Mining of metallic ore deposits in India
1.2. Geographical distribution of important economic metallic deposits in India
1.3. Major underground metal mining industries across India
1.4. Comparison between Underground coal and metal mining Underground Metalliferous Mining Course Code: 4362202
uos: 1.a. Explain historical development and trend of underground metal mining.
1.b. Identify measure metallic deposit and organizations across India.
1.c. Compare underground coal and metal mining.

units.title: Development of Underground Metalliferous Mines
topics: 2.1. General Terminology: Country rock, Footwall, Hangwall, Drift, Cross-cut, level, Stope, Crown pillar, Rib pillar, Sill pillar, Manway, Ore passes with its size, Ore bins, Waste bins, and Winze.
2.2. Mode of entries to underground deposits- Constructional features and applicability conditions of Adit, Shaft, Incline and Decline.
2.3. Drilling patterns – Burn cut and Wedge cut
2.4.1. Selection of level interval and its governing parameters.
2.4.2. Method of Horizontal Drivage – Drift/Cross-cut, main level, sub- level and companion level etc.
2.4.3.1. Raising methods - Open raising, Compartment method, Drop raising, Raising by Alimak raise climber and Raise borers with their cycle of operations.
2.4.3.2. Winzing method with their cycle of operations.
uos: 2.a. Explain general terminology used in underground metal mining.
2.b. Explain various mode of entries with applicability conditions.
2.c. Explain all development parameters used for ore block preparation.
